name: guided-loop
description: The loop remembers — recall hooks, workspace status, skills that speak today, spec debts paid

spec.why: The harness installs everywhere now; the loop must orient itself. A fresh session saying continue should be TOLD where work dangles (open specs, worktrees) and pause to ask which one. Skills still speak the retired CLI. Five spec debts are recorded. This wave pays them.

requirements.text: do where <workspace>: scans live specs roots (archive excluded) + git worktrees; per pack: name, stage, open questions, next ready task, revision, evidence age; --json machine form; exit 0 always.
The recall block: engine-quoted lines only (paths, stages, counts), worktree rows labeled with their tree; when more than one is open it ends with the ask-which-one sentence.

session-recall payload (dual entry): script mode prints the block; pi extension mode injects via session_start + sendMessage; claude SessionStart wiring verified against current docs (refuses what it cannot verify); codex honest subset per Q-3.
The guard hook and the recall hook both ship through the manifest wirings; copilot stays the honest null.
Skills refreshed: zero retired-engine references in sdlc live text; current commands and paths; evals pass; pause-and-ask discipline in analyze/plan/implement.
Skills carry NO bin or brand name: bare subcommands (do where, know validate) and "the harness CLI"; brand:set untouched; brand:check trivially green over harness skills.
§5.3 trust tier helper (advisory: unverified / machine-confirmed / human-reviewed) surfaced in know read + validate info; consumers never reject (§11).
§9 log STRUCTURE joins §8 as the one §11.3 conformance clause (D-6): malformed log.md is an error, not a warning; other §11 checks stay warnings.
stale_after freshness comparison with the injectable clock; status reports stale honestly.
Corpus goldens regenerate ONLY where debt fixes change output; diff reviewed in the commit (contract change on record).

ALL FIVE DEBTS PAID (Q-5): §5.3 helper, §9 log format, §10 Attested Computation admission rules (runtime required; executor/attester shapes), §8 index structure as a §11.3 conformance condition, stale_after comparison — DEBT.md closes each with evidence.
The wave closes through its own loop: evidence rows machine-checked, review rounds recorded, corpus byte-stable at close, closed by human:owner.

THE HARD GATE (Q-4): when more than one spec is open and the FIRST user message is continue-shaped, the loop asks before acting — enforced on pi (message_end replacement + before_agent_start guideline, both doc-verified mechanisms) and claude (UserPromptSubmit block, keys verified at build); codex honestly states the gate is pi+claude; the gate never fires when exactly one or none is open.

clarifications.question: Spec debt §5.3 trust tiers: implement the spec's exact derivation (unverified / machine-confirmed / human-reviewed from  actors) as an ADVISORY helper surfaced in know read + validate info, consumers never reject?

Skills and the brand: skills speak the bin name (treadle today) and brand:set rewrites harness/skills together with the fence (white-label stays true), or skills use neutral phrasing (the harness CLI) with no bin names?
Codex recall: session-start injection is not a codex mechanism — ship the honest subset (a recall prompt-file + notify) and say so in the plan, or defer codex entirely?

The pause-and-ask: soft discipline (the recall block instructs: more than one open spec → ask which one; skills reinforce) or a hard gate (the extension blocks continue-style first messages until a choice is made)?

Spec-debt scope: pay the recall-serving subset this wave (§5.3 helper, §9 log-format validation, stale_after comparison) and record §10 Attested Computation + §8 index-structure as deferred debts, or pay all five now?

out_of_scope: §10 EXECUTION machinery (executor/attester runtimes) — this wave pays the ADMISSION contract only
recall on copilot (no mechanism — the honest null)
hard gate on codex (no mechanism — honestly stated)
do library multi-root/worktree parity (the standing single-root surface) — DEBT row, own wave

decisions.decision: §8 and §9 structure enforce as ONE §11.3 conformance clause (both error-level); "warnings never block" applies to the other §11 checks

verdicts.note: Artifact round: 3 BLOCKER + 6 DEFECT + 5 SMELL, all folded. The blockers were A2 fold gaps: AC-2 still tested the OVERRULED soft discipline (now the enforced gate, falsifiable); T-5 re-defered debts Q-5 ordered paid (now closes all five, only §10 execution machinery deferred with trigger); T-2 verify was a double false-green (unanchored cwd + SKILL.md-only filter that skips 21 live references in resources/assets/evals — now anchored, unfiltered, expect 0). Defects: design soft-line fixed; T-3 corpus promise made fulfillable (generator gains log.md + Attested Computation + staleness cases so the biggest debt fixes have goldens to move); §11.3 single-clause decision recorded as D-6 (proposed, surfaced); diagram names all five; T-4 asserts INSTALLED artifacts; T-1 unpiped. Smells: false T-3→T-2 dependency cut; "first user message" operationally defined (no prior user entry, resumed included); no-git fixture; DES entries landed (stale closing line struck); do library divergence recorded. The reviewer confirmed both pi hard-gate mechanisms against pi docs + types.d.ts and found no invented spec rules.
